$comment: Central benchmark config. The SAME values are used on every target: VMs already have these specs; the Windows host run is CAPPED to them via Job Objects so the bare-metal baseline is fair. Both run.sh and run.ps1 read this file.

vm_spec._note: Control variables. Allocate exactly this in VirtualBox and Hyper-V, and cap the host run to it.

mem._note: sysbench memory on Linux; 7z dictionary throughput on Windows (see DESIGN: not strictly comparable).

net._server_note: A SEPARATE physical box on the same LAN running 'iperf3 -s'. Not the host itself.

app._note: Application-level: large 7z compress of a fixed corpus. Real builds tools (kernel compile) are Linux-only; kept optional.

git._note: Runner PRINTS these commands after a run; it does not push automatically.
